items: 600 grams tomatoes, around 8 medium sized ones
1 green chilli, add an extra to make it spicier
Marinade - you can play around with the spices as per your preference of flavours

450 grams chicken breasts, cubed OR 400 grams paneer, cubed

method: Mix all the ingredients in the marinade and combine with chicken, set aside in the fridge for 1 - 2 hours
Meanwhile, add all the ingredients for the pressure cooker base in the cooker and cook for 3 whistles, switch off and set aside
Once cooled, puree the mix with a little water (the amount of water you put in depends how watery your tomatoes are)
Add the puree to a saucepan and add in the spices and mix ins apart from the kasturi methi and cream and allow to simmer for 15-20 minutes stirring regularly

caption:
No Oil Chicken Curry Recipe
(can be made with paneer as well)
C: 45 | F: 17 | P: 47
Calories: 507 per serving 
Serves 3 people who are on a high protein diet OR 4 normal eaters :) 

Ingredients

Pressure Cooker Base
2 onions
600 grams tomatoes, around 8 medium sized ones 
10 cloves of garlic
1 green chilli, add an extra to make it spicier 
3 kashmiri dried red chilli
8 cashews
3 cloves
3 green cardamom pods
1/2 cup water

Spices + Mix ins 
1 tbsp red chilli powder
1/4 tsp cinnamon powder, optional 
1 tsp garam masala
1 tsp coriander powder
1 tbsp tomato paste
1 tbsp kasuri methi
salt, to taste
1 tbsp fresh cream

Marinade - you can play around with the spices as per your preference of flavours
1/2 cup hung curd OR greek yogurt
2 tbsp ginger garlic paste
1 tbsp red chilli powder
1 tsp haldi powder
1 tsp garam masala
1 tbsp coriander powder
1 tbsp jeera powder
salt, to taste 
450 grams chicken breasts, cubed OR 400 grams paneer, cubed

Method
mix all the ingredients in the marinade and combine with chicken, set aside in the fridge for 1 - 2 hours 
meanwhile, add all the ingredients for the pressure cooker base in the cooker and cook for 3 whistles, switch off and set aside
once cooled, puree the mix with a little water (the amount of water you put in depends how watery your tomatoes are)
add the puree to a saucepan and add in the spices and mix ins apart from the kasturi methi and cream and allow to simmer for 15-20 minutes stirring regularly
while thats simmering, add the chicken to a NON stick saucepan, you wont need oil to coat the pan since its non stick and your chicken / paneer wont stick , the yogurt helps here too
once the chicken is cooked, add it to the curry base and mix in kasturi methi and fresh cream 
serve with a big sprinkle of finely chopped coriander
